tools.name: check_token
tools.description: Is this crypto token a scam? Honeypot buy/sell simulation, hidden taxes, mint/freeze authority, hidden owner, blacklist, whale concentration, liquidity lock. Returns red/yellow/green with reasons. EVM chains + Solana.

tools.name: check_website
tools.description: Is this website a crypto scam or phishing page? Phishing databases, domain age, look-alikes of 45+ crypto brands (MetaMask, Phantom, Binance...), seed-phrase requests, wallet-drainer code. Returns red/yellow/green with reasons.

tools.name: check_wallet
tools.description: Is it safe to send crypto to this address, and is this wallet exposed? Checks scam, phishing, theft, sanctions and mixer links; risky or malicious token approvals (who can drain the wallet); contract vs personal wallet; brand-new 'poisoned' look-alike addresses. Returns red/yellow/green with reasons

tools.name: get_wallet_balances
tools.description: Get a wallet's balances: native coin (ETH, BNB, POL, AVAX, SOL) and tokens. Solana: every SPL token held. EVM: popular tokens on the chain plus any token addresses you pass. Also returns transactions sent and whether the address is a contract.

tools.name: get_transaction
tools.description: Look up a transaction by hash: success/failed/pending, confirmations, time, sender, receiver, value, fee, method, decoded token and NFT transfers, and token approvals it granted (flags unlimited approvals). Solana: balance changes per account.

tools.name: get_token_info
tools.description: Read a token's on-chain details: name, symbol, decimals, total supply. Solana: supply, decimals, mint authority and freeze authority.

tools.name: read_webpage
tools.description: Fetch any public web page and return clean Markdown of its main content (headings, lists, links, code), plus title and description. Strips menus, footers, ads and scripts so it is ready for an LLM. Not charged if the page can't be fetched.

tools.name: check_email
tools.description: Check an email address before sending or signing someone up: valid format, domain exists and accepts mail (MX), throwaway/disposable domain, typo suggestions (gmial.com → gmail.com), role addresses (info@, support@), SPF/DMARC. Returns valid / risky / invalid with reasons.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_webpage, check_email · Private data: check_token, check_website, check_wallet, get_wallet_balances, get_transaction, get_token_info · Public sink: check_wallet, check_email · Destructive: check_email.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_webpage, check_email · Private data: check_token, check_website, check_wallet, get_wallet_balances, get_transaction, get_token_info · Public sink: check_wallet, check_email · Destructive: check_email

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
